notes.title: Join the Vulgord's Tower Livestream During Steam's Digital Tabletop Fest
notes.notes:
Join us for a livestream of Vulgord's Tower on Saturday, October, 23 at 6 pm EDT during Steam's Tabletop RPG fest. 

We'll be available to chat and to answer your questions during the stream.

Vulgord's Tower and soundtrack are also discounted 50% off for the entire fest from 1 pm on the 21st to 1 pm on the 25th of October.

Slay you there!

notes.title: Play the Vulgord's Tower Demo at Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
[h1]Vulgord's Tower will be celebrating Steam's NEXT Fest with a free playable demo of the game![/h1]

You will be able to access the demo on our store page for the entire NEXT fest event from[b] June 16th, 2021 at 1 pm EST[/b], to[b] June 22nd, 2021 at 1 pm EST[/b].

Vulgord's Tower Store Page:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1457340/Vulgords_Tower/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1457340/Vulgords_Tower/[/url]

DEMO SPECS
[list]
[*] Limited 2-hour demo - play in multiplayer or single-player mode

notes.title: Vulgord’s Tower Debuts on Steam
notes.notes:
[h1]Sharpen your blade, gather your army, and prepare for mayhem![/h1]

The madness of Vulgord has descended upon the Steam platform!

The game was successfully backed on [url=http://kck.st/3ubVxNn]Kickstarter [/url]and is available on Steam for PC and MAC OS. Download the game now for $12.99 usd:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1457340/Vulgords_Tower/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1457340/Vulgords_Tower/[/url]

[h3]Looking to hook up with other players?[/h3]
Vulgord's Tower is so much more fun when you play with an opponent. Join us on our brand new Discord to connect with the developers and other players: [url=https://discord.gg/pjSXUKEBYS]https://discord.gg/pjSXUKEBYS[/url]

notes.title: Vulgord's Tower Kickstarter Launches Tuesday, March 30th, 2021 @ 12am EST
notes.notes:
We’ve been anxiously awaiting this moment! We will be launching our Kickstarter in just a few days (on Tuesday, March 30th)!

[h2]Follow the Kickstarter now to receive an update when it goes live![/h2]

[url=http://kck.st/3ubVxNn]http://kck.st/3ubVxNn[/url]

We’ve been developing Vulgord’s Tower for nearly four years now and it’s hard to believe we’ve made it to this point. We never imagined how much time, money, and work would go into this. Building a complete multiplayer game from scratch has been a labor of love and a huge undertaking. This Kickstarter campaign will help us recover our out-of-pocket costs and may also enable us to add even more features to the game!

You will get two copies of the game if you support the Kickstarter (because games are always more fun when you play with friends)! Obtain a copy of the Dungeon Synth Vulgord’s Tower Soundtrack, have yourself added as a character in the game, get the T-Shirt, and much more!

If you just want to support what we’re doing, you can donate any amount you want, without receiving anything in return.

[h2]We welcome whatever amount you can donate![/h2]

Every penny counts, and how much you donate isn’t as important as the difference you’ll make to our campaign by helping us reach that key 30% goal within the first 24 hours!

[h2]Check out our stretch goals to see all the additional features we would love to add to the game[/h2]

Along the way, we’ve had plenty of time to dream up new ideas to make the game even cooler. Help us reach our stretch goals to add these awesome new features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39862927/e9991dda9984da58d3587fd54ee819b268fd7324.png[/img]

You can help give our campaign its initial boost, and help us reach our stretch goals by making your pledge on Tuesday, March 30th!

[h2]Follow the Kickstarter to make a pledge:[/h2]

[url=http://kck.st/3ubVxNn]http://kck.st/3ubVxNn[/url]

Once you have done that, it would mean the world to us if you’d spread the word by sharing our campaign with your friends on Facebook or Twitter.

You can make a HUGE difference with just a few clicks!

[b]Thank you so much for your support.[/b]
